original_title: 5 Years Later, Cool Cyberpunk Shooter The Ascent Is Getting a Major Update — and It Sounds Like a Sequel Is in the Works
summary_en: Five years after its stunning debut, the cyberpunk shooter **The Ascent** is preparing for a significant overhaul. Publisher Krafton has announced a November 2026 update promising a more stable experience, with hints strongly suggesting a sequel is on the horizon.

en.title: The Ascent Gets Major Update, Hinting at Sequel and New Platforms
en.summary: Five years after its stunning debut, the cyberpunk shooter **The Ascent** is preparing for a significant overhaul. Publisher Krafton has announced a November 2026 update promising a more stable experience, with hints strongly suggesting a sequel is on the horizon.
en.body:
## A Welcome Return to Veles

It’s been five years since players first descended into the grimy, neon-drenched metropolis of Veles in **The Ascent**. Released in 2021, Neon Giant’s ambitious twin-stick action RPG immediately captivated audiences with its breathtakingly detailed environments and visceral combat. While its narrative and character development may not have reached the same heights as its visual spectacle, the core gameplay loop of fast-paced gunplay and ultra-violence in a co-op-friendly cyberpunk world made it a standout experience. Now, publisher Krafton is bringing players back to Veles with a surprise major update, coinciding with the game's fifth anniversary, and the implications are substantial.

The upcoming update, slated for November 2026, is designed to address key player feedback, promising a "smoother, more dependable experience for solo and co-op players." Specific improvements will target co-op teleportation, the encounter system, and the reliability of save games and player progression. These enhancements are crucial for refining the game's already strong foundation, ensuring that the unique Veles experience is as seamless as possible for its millions of players.

> "We are incredibly proud of what we built with **The Ascent** and grateful to the millions of players who have made the journey to Veles," said Arcade Berg, co-founder of Neon Giant. "We have also listened closely to feedback about where the experience can be"

## What This Means for Fans

Beyond the technical improvements, Krafton’s announcement also contains a tantalizing glimpse into the future. The statement explicitly mentions "plans to expand **The Ascent** across new platforms, genres, and future sequels." This is the clearest indication yet that the team at Neon Giant is not only committed to polishing their debut title but also to building upon its success in significant ways. The mention of "new genres" is particularly intriguing, sparking speculation about potential spin-offs or entirely new takes on the **The Ascent** universe. Could we see a first-person perspective entry, or perhaps a strategy game set in the same world? The possibilities are vast, and the confirmation of future sequels suggests that the core twin-stick shooter experience will likely continue to evolve.

## What's Next

While specific details about the sequel and new platform plans are still under wraps, the November 2026 update for the original **The Ascent** serves as a strong prelude. Players can anticipate a more robust and polished experience from the current game, while the broader hints from Krafton fuel excitement for what’s to come.

es.title: El Ascenso Recibe Una Actualización Importante, Haciendo Preguntar Sobre Una Secuela y Nuevas Plataformas
es.summary: Después de su impresionante debut hace cinco años, el juego de disparos en perspectiva ciberpunk **The Ascent** se prepara para una renovación significativa. El editor Krafton ha anunciado una actualización para noviembre de 2026 que promete una experiencia más estable, con insinuaciones que sugieren fuertemente que una secuela está en el horizonte. Esta actualización no solo refina la experiencia existente, sino que también abre la puerta a nuevas posibilidades para la franquicia.
es.body:
## Un Regreso Bienvenido a Veles

Han pasado cinco años desde que los jugadores primero descendieron a la metrópolis llena de neón y grime de Veles en **The Ascent**. Lanzado en 2021, el ambicioso juego de rol de acción en perspectiva ciberpunk de Neon Giant capturó inmediatamente a las audiencias con sus entornos detallados y su combate visceral. Aunque su narrativa y desarrollo de personajes pueden no haber alcanzado las mismas alturas que su espectáculo visual, el núcleo del juego de disparos rápidos y violencia ultra en un mundo ciberpunk amigable para el juego cooperativo lo convirtió en una experiencia destacada. Ahora, el editor Krafton está trayendo a los jugadores de regreso a Veles con una actualización importante, coincidiendo con el quinto aniversario del juego, y las implicaciones son sustanciales.

La actualización upcoming, programada para noviembre de 2026, está diseñada para abordar la retroalimentación clave de los jugadores, prometiendo una "experiencia más suave y confiable para jugadores en solitario y cooperativo". Las mejoras específicas se centrarán en la teletransportación cooperativa, el sistema de encuentros y la confiabilidad de los juegos guardados y el progreso del jugador. Estas mejoras son cruciales para refinar la base ya sólida del juego, asegurando que la experiencia única de Veles sea lo más fluida posible para sus millones de jugadores.

> "Estamos increíblemente orgullosos de lo que construimos con **The Ascent** y agradecidos a los millones de jugadores que han hecho el viaje a Veles," dijo Arcade Berg, cofundador de Neon Giant. "También hemos escuchado atentamente la retroalimentación sobre dónde puede mejorar la experiencia"

## Qué Significa Esto para los Fans

Más allá de las mejoras técnicas, el anuncio de Krafton también contiene un vistazo tentador al futuro. La declaración menciona explícitamente "planes para expandir **The Ascent** a través de nuevas plataformas, géneros y secuelas futuras". Esta es la indicación más clara hasta ahora de que el equipo de Neon Giant no solo se compromete a pulir su título debut, sino también a construir sobre su éxito de maneras significativas. La mención de "nuevos géneros" es particularmente intrigante, lo que genera especulación sobre posibles spin-offs o tomas completamente nuevas del universo de **The Ascent**. ¿Podríamos ver una entrada en perspectiva en primera persona, o quizás un juego de estrategia ambientado en el mismo mundo? Las posibilidades son vastas, y la confirmación de futuras secuelas sugiere que la experiencia central del juego de disparos en perspectiva ciberpunk probablemente seguirá evolucionando.

## Próximos Pasos

Si bien los detalles específicos sobre la secuela y los planes de nuevas plataformas aún están bajo secreto, la actualización de noviembre de 2026 para el **The Ascent** original sirve como un fuerte preludio. Los jugadores pueden anticipar una experiencia más robusta y pulida del juego actual, mientras que las insinuaciones más amplias de Krafton alimentan la emoción por lo que está por venir.

content_raw: The Ascent is set for a surprise major update to coincide with the game’s fifth anniversary — and it sounds like a sequel is on the way. Neon Giant’s twin-stick action RPG impressed players upon its 2021 release for its punchy action, highly detailed environments, and beautiful cyberpunk aesthetic. In IGN’s The Ascent review , we said, “The Ascent’s satisfying gun-tastic action-RPG gameplay loop mixes with its beautiful cyberpunk aesthetic to create an overall enjoyable experience. Neither its story nor its characters are all that memorable, and its enemy encounters can stumble toward the end, but its gunplay and ultra-violence in a neon-soaked world combine to craft a co-op-friendly game you don’t see every day.” Now, publisher Krafton has announced that the upcoming update, due out in November 2026, will bring “a smoother more dependable experience for solo and co-op players, including improvements to co-op teleportation, the encounter system, save-game reliability and player-progression reliability.” And then this interesting note: “Final details will be shared closer to release alongside plans to expand The Ascent across new platforms, genres and future sequels. “ That to me sounds a lot like The Ascent 2 is in the works, and perhaps a Nintendo Switch 2 version of The Ascent is coming. But the mention of new genres is interesting, too. Could a full-blown first-person action RPG The Ascent game be a possibility? Given The Ascent has had over 12 million players, perhaps news of a sequel shouldn’t come as a surprise. “We are incredibly proud of what we built with The Ascent and grateful to the millions of players who have made the journey to Veles,” said Arcade Berg, co-founder of Neon Giant. “We have also listened closely to feedback about where the experience can be stronger. With Krafton’s support, this update marks a new chapter for the game and for our ambitions for The Ascent as a franchise.” Swedish studio Neon Giant is made up of only 20 developers, but it has a lot on its plate. Not only is it working on this The Ascent update as well as whatever’s next for the franchise, but it’s developing the promising No Law, which looks a bit like Cyberpunk 2077. I recently interviewed the team about how it’s developing No Law , which has a number of really exciting features open world fans will be keen to hear about. Wesley is Director, News at IGN.
